speaker: consultant
text: Good morning, this is Elena Ward.

speaker: customer
text: Good morning, Elena. This is Sofia Marin. We had a discovery call two weeks ago about my dental practice.

speaker: consultant
text: Yes, hello Sofia. Thank you for calling back.

speaker: customer
text: I wanted to let you know personally that we will not go ahead with the Growth Package.

speaker: consultant
text: Thank you for telling me. May I ask why?

speaker: customer
text: We decided to hire a full-time office manager instead. She will take over scheduling and billing.

speaker: consultant
text: That sounds like a sensible choice for a practice of your size.

speaker: customer
text: We thought so too. It was not about your offer, it just fits our situation better.

speaker: consultant
text: I appreciate that. If your new manager ever wants a single session to set up processes, I am happy to help.

speaker: customer
text: I will mention it to her. How much was the single session again?

speaker: consultant
text: One hundred and eighty dollars for ninety minutes, with a written summary.

speaker: customer
text: Okay. I will pass that on, but I don't expect we will need it soon.

speaker: consultant
text: That is perfectly fine. Should I remove you from my follow-up list?

speaker: customer
text: Yes, please. We are not planning to work with a consultant right now.

speaker: consultant
text: Done. Thank you for letting me know, Sofia.

speaker: customer
text: Thank you, Elena. Have a good day.
